quote: Outside of a list, use a button that behaves like a toggle, not a switch.
In general, don’t replace a checkbox with a switch.

case: Nielsen Norman Group · Alita Joyce, Toggle-Switch Guidelines
quote: Toggle switches should take immediate effect and should not require the user to click Save or Submit to apply the new state.

case: United Airlines для iOS — реальный кейс, разбор NN/g
quote: In the United Airlines iOS app, other than the visual change, nothing happens when users tap the toggle switch.

case: Apple iOS, режим полёта — реальный кейс, разбор NN/g
quote: When turning airplane mode on for iOS, Apple provides immediate results by changing the cellular bars in the upper left-hand corner to an airplane icon.

behavior: не ставить свитч в форму с Save
quote: If you’re considering including toggles in long forms where other types of form fields are present, and users will need to click a Submit button for other changes to take effect, don’t.
`Switch` will trigger a state change directly when you toggle it, while `Checkbox` is generally used for state marking, which should work in conjunction with submit operation.
You don’t need to supply a label in this situation because the content in the row provides the context for the state the switch controls.
